about: A technical university founded in 1842, on a campus of its own south of the medieval centre of Delft, twenty minutes from The Hague and an hour from Amsterdam. Seventeen three-year BSc programmes, of which four are taught fully in English: Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Earth, Climate and Technology, and Nanobiology. Three of those four are numerus fixus, which means an IB student's realistic Delft shortlist is decided on 15 January rather than in July.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you outright, but the only route TU Delft publishes is narrow, slow, and not on the pages an IB applicant is sent to. TU Delft admits on diplomas: it states that it "does not accept separate Dutch language certificates, English language certificates, or individual VWO subject certificates as a basis for admission", and individual VWO subject certificates — vwo-deelcertificaten — are exactly what Nuffic compares DP Course Results to. The published alternative is the colloquium doctum, which TU Delft documents only on its Dutch-diploma pages, and those pages send every IB holder away to the international-diploma route where the word never appears. To use it you must be 21 or older on the day the programme starts, show sufficient proficiency in Dutch — TU Delft states this applies to its English-taught programmes too — and meet the English requirement as well. No syllabus, deadline or fee is published: you arrange it by emailing contactcentre-esa@tudelft.nl with 'Colloquium Doctum' in the subject. Two things on the site look like routes and are not. The Dutch foundation-year programmes TU Delft lists sit inside a section that applies only to recognised refugees holding a Dutch residence permit, and TU Delft offers no foundation year of its own. The hbo propedeuse and associate degree route needs you to be admitted to a Dutch hogeschool first, and that asks for a havo, vwo or mbo-4 diploma, which brings you back to where you started. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the only route that reaches this programme at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you outright, but the only route TU Delft publishes is narrow, slow, and not on the pages an IB applicant is sent to. TU Delft admits on diplomas: it states that it "does not accept separate Dutch language certificates, English language certificates, or individual VWO subject certificates as a basis for admission", and individual VWO subject certificates — vwo-deelcertificaten — are exactly what Nuffic compares DP Course Results to. To use it you must be 21 or older on the day the programme starts, show sufficient proficiency in Dutch — TU Delft states this applies to its English-taught programmes too — and meet the English requirement as well. No syllabus, deadline or fee is published: you arrange it by emailing contactcentre-esa@tudelft.nl with 'Colloquium Doctum' in the subject. Two things on the site look like routes and are not. The Dutch foundation-year programmes TU Delft lists sit inside a section that applies only to recognised refugees holding a Dutch residence permit, and TU Delft offers no foundation year of its own. The hbo propedeuse and associate degree route needs you to be admitted to a Dutch hogeschool first, and that asks for a havo, vwo or mbo-4 diploma, which brings you back to where you started. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the only route that reaches this programme at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you outright, but the only route TU Delft publishes is narrow, slow, and not on the pages an IB applicant is sent to. TU Delft admits on diplomas: it states that it "does not accept separate Dutch language certificates, English language certificates, or individual VWO subject certificates as a basis for admission", and individual VWO subject certificates — vwo-deelcertificaten — are exactly what Nuffic compares DP Course Results to. The published alternative is the colloquium doctum, which TU Delft documents only on its Dutch-diploma pages, and those pages send every IB holder away to the international-diploma route where the word never appears. To use it you must be 21 or older on the day the programme starts, show sufficient proficiency in Dutch — TU Delft states this applies to its English-taught programmes too — and meet the English requirement as well. No syllabus, deadline or fee is published: you arrange it by emailing contactcentre-esa@tudelft.nl with 'Colloquium Doctum' in the subject. Two things on the site look like routes and are not. The Dutch foundation-year programmes TU Delft lists sit inside a section that applies only to recognised refugees holding a Dutch residence permit, and TU Delft offers no foundation year of its own. The hbo propedeuse and associate degree route needs you to be admitted to a Dutch hogeschool first, and that asks for a havo, vwo or mbo-4 diploma, which brings you back to where you started. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the only route that reaches this programme at eighteen. requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you outright, but the only route TU Delft publishes is narrow, slow, and not on the pages an IB applicant is sent to. TU Delft admits on diplomas: it states that it "does not accept separate Dutch language certificates, English language certificates, or individual VWO subject certificates as a basis for admission", and individual VWO subject certificates — vwo-deelcertificaten — are exactly what Nuffic compares DP Course Results to. The published alternative is the colloquium doctum, which TU Delft documents only on its Dutch-diploma pages, and those pages send every IB holder away to the international-diploma route where the word never appears. To use it you must be 21 or older on the day the programme starts, show sufficient proficiency in Dutch — TU Delft states this applies to its English-taught programmes too — and meet the English requirement as well. No syllabus, deadline or fee is published: you arrange it by emailing contactcentre-esa@tudelft.nl with 'Colloquium Doctum' in the subject. Two things on the site look like routes and are not. The Dutch foundation-year programmes TU Delft lists sit inside a section that applies only to recognised refugees holding a Dutch residence permit, and TU Delft offers no foundation year of its own. The hbo propedeuse and associate degree route needs you to be admitted to a Dutch hogeschool first, and that asks for a havo, vwo or mbo-4 diploma, which brings you back to where you started. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the only route that reaches this programme at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.
